tasks.description: Set up Supabase JS client for 0509. Add @supabase/supabase-js dependency. Create lib/supabase.ts with createClient using env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). Implement auth: email/password signup + login, Google OAuth. Create /auth/login and /auth/signup page routes. Add auth middleware (middleware.ts) to protect /dashboard routes. Create profiles table migration (id, email, plan, created_at). Store session in cookies. Add auth state to a React context provider.

tasks.title: Meta Ad Library API integration (server-side proxy)
tasks.description: Create a Next.js API route that proxies search requests to Meta's Ad Library API. The route should accept search params (advertiser name, keyword, country, platform, creative type, status) and return normalized AdRecord[] matching the existing type in demo-data.ts. Handle Meta API authentication (access token from env var). Implement rate limiting awareness (respect Meta's rate limits). Parse Meta's response format into our AdRecord interface. Support pagination via Meta's cursor-based pagination. Error handling for auth failures, rate limits, invalid queries.
files_to_modify: src/app/api/ads/search/route.ts (create — Meta Ad Library API proxy)
src/lib/meta-api.ts (create — Meta API client, auth, response parsing)
src/lib/demo-data.ts (modify — export AdRecord type separately for reuse)
tasks.notes: THIS IS THE ENTIRE PRODUCT. Meta Ad Library API docs: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/api/. Requires a Meta app with ads_read permission. The API returns ad creative, copy, targeting, spend ranges, active status. Map Meta's response to our AdRecord type. Keep demo-data.ts as fallback when META_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set.

tasks.title: Saved searches + ad bookmarks (Supabase persistence)
tasks.description: Create Supabase tables: saved_searches (id, user_id, name, query_params JSONB, created_at, last_run_at) and bookmarked_ads (id, user_id, ad_data JSONB, notes TEXT, created_at). Add API routes for CRUD on both. Create /dashboard page showing saved searches with run counts and last-run dates. Add bookmark button to ad cards in search results. Add save search button to search page. Show bookmarked ads in /dashboard/bookmarks. Requires auth (Z-BE-001).
files_to_modify: src/app/dashboard/page.tsx (create — user dashboard with saved searches)
src/components/search-demo.tsx (modify — add save search + bookmark buttons)
tasks.notes: This is what makes 0509 sticky — users save searches to track competitors over time. Each saved search stores the full query params so it can be re-run. Bookmarked ads store the full ad data as JSONB so they persist even if the ad is pulled from Meta.
